title: It's heavy and big!!!
text:
It's heavy and big!!!. I have a ten year old clothes steamer that still sells today on Amazon for half the price; and I think it works just as good. Actually maybe better simply because I can only get one shirt done before needing to refill this CHI steamer; where as I can get two shirts done with my old unit. Nor did the CHI save me any time. It simply doesn't work any better on my husband's dress work shirts than our old steamer.
And as I mentioned before, this unit is large and quite heavy (especially once filled with water). So I wouldn't be packing it for him on his business trips. The only thing that I did like about this steamer is that it has a very long cord, that didn't get tangled up easily. And of course it is sturdy and it looks pretty. My bottom line: I am usually a huge fan of CHI products, but I think you'd be paying a high mark-up for the CHI name if you purchased this one.

product_metadata.title: CHI Handheld Garment Steamer for Clothes, 2 Continuous Steam Modes, Full-Size 300 ml Capacity Water Tank, Ergonomic Handle, Vacation Essentials, 1600 Watts, 10’ Cord, Red (11590)

READY TO STEAM IN SECONDS WITH 1600 WATTS OF POWER. This powerful handheld garment steamer heats up quickly so you never have to wait. It has 1600 watts of power for fast heat-up and excellent steam performance.

LARGE 300 ML CAPACITY WATER TANK. Steam away wrinkles on garments and fabrics around your home for a long time without refilling. The large water tank gives you plenty of steam time, and when it’s time to add water, the large opening makes filling easy.
ERGONOMIC HANDLE AND WELL-BALANCED WEIGHT FOR COMFORTABLE STEAMING. The ergonomic handle is easy to grasp and ensures that you can comfortably move and direct the steam right where you need it.

EXTRA-LONG 10 FT. CORD: With a longer cord, you'll be able to steam hard-to-reach areas, including drapes. The 10 ft. cord gives you plenty of reach when you need it, and you can plug this compact garment steamer in where it's most convenient.
description: The CHI® Handheld Garment Steamer makes it easy to remove wrinkles from any fabric. It has a steam pump for reliable steam power along with 2 continuous steam modes: normal and MAX. Ready to steam in seconds. Includes large 300 ml water tank.
